entry_valuation_stated: Exact entry average unknown. November2005 proposedUS$45–50/share andUS$46bn owned/controlled property valuation are later thesis inputs, not September public facts. Snapshot priceUS$33.49 and conventional metrics computed separately.
outcome_note: Original McOpCoIPO not adopted. Investor revised the proposal and supported negotiated refranchising/disclosure/capital actions. Q2 2009 original investor letter states prior stake soldQ4 2007 at approximatelyUS$56/share; exact realized P&L unknown. This was a profitable investment despite failure of the original transaction demand. Separate2009 repurchase is a new passive investment, not continuation of2005 options. Key lesson: protect franchise-system economics and adapt engagement; do not equate rejecting a transaction with failed stock performance.
